reason: I already have INDmoney and Fold pulling my bank data for free, so linking my account again to a brand-new app from one developer with zero reviews feels like risk for not much gain. I might try the free tier someday, but I would not pay for Pro now.
objection: Who is actually holding my bank data, and what happens to it if this solo developer shuts the app down in six months?
would_change_my_mind: A few months of real reviews plus a clear, simple privacy page showing it is a registered AA user with data deletion on request, and the WhatsApp one-line entry working well enough that it also replaces my Splitwise hassle.
